sqlite: CREATE TABLE "migrations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "migration" varchar not null, "batch" integer not null)
CREATE TABLE "password_reset_tokens" ("email" varchar not null, "token" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, primary key ("email"))
CREATE TABLE "sessions" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer, "ip_address" varchar, "user_agent" text, "payload" text not null, "last_activity" integer not null, primary key ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "cache" ("key" varchar not null, "value" text not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))
CREATE TABLE "cache_locks" ("key" varchar not null, "owner" varchar not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

CREATE TABLE "jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "attempts" integer not null, "reserved_at" integer, "available_at" integer not null, "created_at" integer not null)

CREATE TABLE "job_batches" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "total_jobs" integer not null, "pending_jobs" integer not null, "failed_jobs" integer not null, "failed_job_ids" text not null, "options" text, "cancelled_at" integer, "created_at" integer not null, "finished_at" integer, primary key ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "failed_jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "uuid" varchar not null, "connection" varchar not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "exception" text not null, "failed_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE "passkeys" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "credential_id" varchar not null, "credential" text not null, "last_used_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete cascade)

CREATE TABLE "workspaces" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null, "slug" varchar not null, "timezone" varchar not null default 'America/Boise', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

CREATE TABLE "memberships" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "role" varchar not null default 'viewer', "permissions" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "workspace_domains" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "hostname" varchar not null, "verified_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null, "email" varchar not null, "email_verified_at" datetime, "password" varchar not null, "remember_token" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "two_factor_secret" text, "two_factor_recovery_codes" text, "two_factor_confirmed_at" datetime, "current_workspace_id" integer, "setup_token_hash" varchar, "setup_expires_at" datetime, foreign key("current_workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "vehicles" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "kind" varchar not null, "fuel_type" varchar, "year" integer, "vin" varchar, "notes" text, "source_key" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "captures" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "created_by" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer, "kind" varchar not null, "source" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'review', "title" varchar not null, "notes" text, "payload" text not null, "uncertainties" text, "idempotency_key" varchar not null, "request_hash" varchar not null, "accepted_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id"), foreign key("vehicle_id") references "vehicles"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "attachments" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "capture_id" integer not null, "original_name" varchar not null, "path" varchar not null, "mime_type" varchar not null, "bytes" integer not null, "sha256" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("capture_id") references "captures"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "service_records" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "capture_id" integer, "created_by" integer not null, "kind" varchar not null, "title" varchar not null, "occurred_on" date, "date_precision" varchar not null default 'day', "odometer" numeric, "odometer_approximate" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "cost" numeric, "vendor" varchar, "parts" text, "notes" text, "source_key" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("vehicle_id") references "vehicles"("id"), foreign key("capture_id") references "captures"("id"), foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "fuel_fills" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "capture_id" integer, "created_by" integer not null, "filled_at" datetime not null, "odometer" numeric not null, "gallons" numeric not null, "price_per_gallon" numeric, "total_cost" numeric, "fuel_type" varchar not null, "full_tank" tinyint(1) not null, "missed_fill" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "trip_miles" numeric, "dashboard_mpg" numeric, "station" varchar, "notes" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("vehicle_id") references "vehicles"("id"), foreign key("capture_id") references "captures"("id"), foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "odometer_readings" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "created_by" integer not null, "capture_id" integer, "observed_on" date not null, "miles" numeric not null, "notes" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("vehicle_id") references "vehicles"("id"), foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id"), foreign key("capture_id") references "captures"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "maintenance_tasks" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "title" varchar not null, "notes" text, "due_on" date, "due_odometer" numeric, "status" varchar not null default 'open', "source_key" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("vehicle_id") references "vehicles"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "foods" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "serving" varchar not null, "legacy_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "current_version_id" integer, foreign key("user_id") references users("id") on delete no action on update no action, foreign key("workspace_id") references workspaces("id") on delete no action on update no action, foreign key("current_version_id") references "food_versions"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "audit_events" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "action" varchar not null, "entity_type" varchar not null, "entity_id" integer not null, "details" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("workspace_id") references "workspaces"("id"), foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id"))

CREATE TABLE "oauth_auth_codes" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer not null, "client_id" varchar not null, "scopes" text, "revoked" tinyint(1) not null, "expires_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "oauth_access_tokens" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer, "client_id" varchar not null, "name" varchar, "scopes" text, "revoked" tinyint(1) not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "expires_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "oauth_refresh_tokens" ("id" varchar not null, "access_token_id" varchar not null, "revoked" tinyint(1) not null, "expires_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "oauth_clients" ("id" varchar not null, "owner_type" varchar, "owner_id" integer, "name" varchar not null, "secret" varchar, "provider" varchar, "redirect_uris" text not null, "grant_types" text not null, "revoked" tinyint(1) not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "oauth_device_codes" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer, "client_id" varchar not null, "user_code" varchar not null, "scopes" text not null, "revoked" tinyint(1) not null, "user_approved_at" datetime, "last_polled_at" datetime, "expires_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "food_versions" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "food_id" integer not null, "calories" numeric not null, "protein" numeric not null, "fat" numeric not null, "carbs" numeric not null, "source_type" varchar not null default ('manual'), "source_note" text, "is_estimate" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "legacy_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("food_id") references foods("id") on delete no action on update no action)

CREATE TABLE "meal_entries" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "workspace_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "food_version_id" integer not null, "date" date not null, "meal" varchar not null, "qty" numeric not null, "unit" varchar, "note" text, "migration_baseline" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "legacy_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "idempotency_key" varchar, "request_hash" varchar, "deleted_at" datetime, foreign key("food_version_id") references food_versions("id") on delete no action on update no action, foreign key("user_id") references users("id") on delete no action on update no action, foreign key("workspace_id") references workspaces("id") on delete no action on update no action)
